'''The Pinnacle''' was a tall rock formation that was located in the middle of the [[Mos Espa Grand Arena/Legends|Mos Espa Arena]], on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Centuries prior to the arena's construction, it was a sacred site for the [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]], where sacrifices and rituals intended to promote good hunting seasons were performed. After being chased away, members of local Tusken Raider bands would regularly shoot at passing [[Podracer/Legends|podracers]], in order to avenge their ancestors.
